title: Oriental Pearl Tower
summary: The Oriental Pearl Radio & TV Tower stands at Lujiazui in Pudong, Shanghai, beside the Huangpu River. It is 468 m tall and combines sightseeing, dining, shopping and broadcasting. Sources differ on dating: construction began in 1990, and it is recorded as completed in 1994 or 1995.

uncertainty.note: CTBUH gives construction 1990 and completion 1995; Travel China Guide gives completion and public opening in 1994.
